decisions.statement: An element named is tapped before anything is typed into that element.
The element tapped is named as soon as that element is tapped.
A typing that threw after that tap names the tap in its refusal.
The text is named as sent before that text is sent.
A typing that threw on the send names that send in its refusal.
A call naming no element names the send into the element already focused.
The session, the finding, the tapping and the typing are handed in.
A call naming no element types into the element already focused.
How many characters went in is the answer rather than the text.

definition: the command typing text into the simulator's webview
